SelfText maintains a local BSD-licensed flutter_local_notifications 20.1.0 copy. The upstream LICENSE is retained. Android createNotification uses compact, expanded and heads-up RemoteViews only for selftext_alarm_v3, with Snooze/Dismiss wired to the original background ActionBroadcastReceiver pending intents. This makes the two essential controls visible in the collapsed notification as well. All other channels keep upstream behavior.
